title: KMP Substring Search
description: Given strings `haystack` and `needle`, return the index of the first occurrence of `needle` in `haystack`, or -1 if it does not occur. The empty needle occurs at index 0. Input: two strings. Output: the first matching index or -1.
constraints: Both strings contain lowercase English letters
hints: Keep track of the smallest state needed to continue matching or comparing characters.
Test empty, one-character, repeated-character, and boundary inputs.
